units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:11">Gen. R. s. 91</cite>, end <he>ה׳ הכסף וכ׳</he> here is the silver &c.—
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:4">Ab. III, 4</cite>, a. fr. <he>ה׳ זה וכ׳</he> such a person is &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 5:3">Bets. V, 3</cite>, a. fr. <he>ה׳ אלו וכ׳</he> in this case they are &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 9:2">B. Kam. IX, 2</cite> <he>ה׳ שלך לפניך</he> here is thy property before thee (take it in the condition in which it is); a. v. fr.—<he>הֲרֵינִי</he> = <he>ה׳ אני</he> behold, I am, will be &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 1:1">Naz. I, 1</cite> <he>ה׳ נזיר</he> I will be a Nazir.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 31b">Kidd. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ כפרת וכ׳</he> may I be the atonement for his rest (a blessing formula for a deceased father); a. fr.

senses.gloss: ה׳ ש׳־ here is a case of one, if.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 3b:14">Meg. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ שהיה וכ׳</he> if one is going to slaughter &c.; a. fr.
